summary: Use current atom demand rather than deferred disposal when admitting conversation follows or reacquiring native subject reads.

replay.detail: No claim or replay behavior change.

schema.detail: No database or gateway schema change.

rules.detail: No checkpoint or fleet coordination change.

compatibility.detail: Navigation can immediately release a conversation slot before the outgoing atom finalizer runs, while still-mounted readers retain ownership. Native subject reads reacquired after their last owner leaves revalidate instead of replaying an orphan live observation.

downtime.detail: No daemon restart or downtime is required.

recovery.detail: Revert the web demand-ownership change to restore the preceding browser behavior.
